output.population: 322 moderately obese adults (mean age 52 years; mean BMI 31; 86% male) followed for 2 years.

output.outcome: Body-weight change at 2 years; lipid measures and glycemic measures were secondary outcomes.
output.effect: Mean weight loss was 2.9 kg with low-fat, 4.4 kg with Mediterranean, and 4.7 kg with low-carbohydrate diets (P<0.001 for diet-by-time interaction).
